visual.summary: Carrot field module: a fenced plot either side of a water trench with barrels and lanterns; plainer than the wheat field.
problems: It's the same plot as the wheat field without the scarecrow: give each crop module one thing of its own (a carrot crate and rabbit-proof fence, a potato sack pile and a digging fork).
The fence sits on a raised plank rim, so the field is a step above the ground; check soldiers can walk in.
